fields.Name: Lorna Dane
fields.Background: Lorna Dane, known as Polaris, is a mutant with magnetic powers and the daughter of Magneto, one of the most powerful mutants in existence. Growing up unaware of her heritage, she discovered her abilities during her teenage years when her powers manifested in moments of extreme emotion. After learning about her connection to Magneto, Lorna struggled with her identity, torn between following in her father's footsteps or forging her own path. She has been a member of various mutant teams including the X-Men and X-Factor, fighting to protect both mutants and humans while dealing with her complicated family legacy.
fields.Strengths: Lorna possesses the mutant ability to control magnetic fields, similar to her father Magneto but at a somewhat lesser scale. She can manipulate ferrous metals, create magnetic force fields for protection, and even fly by manipulating magnetic currents. Her powers allow her to sense and track metal objects across considerable distances. Beyond her abilities, Lorna has received combat training and strategic education through her work with various mutant teams. She has shown strong leadership capabilities when leading X-Factor and other groups. Her experience in dealing with both human and mutant conflicts has given her valuable diplomatic skills. Lorna's determination to prove herself independent of her father's shadow drives her to continuously improve and develop her abilities.
fields.Weaknesses: Lorna's powers are directly tied to her emotional state, and extreme emotional distress can cause her to lose control of her abilities, potentially endangering those around her. Her complex relationship with her father Magneto has been a source of psychological turmoil, leading to identity crises and questioning of her own moral compass. She has struggled with mental health issues including periods of depression and has been vulnerable to psychic manipulation due to her emotional vulnerabilities. The constant comparison to Magneto's greater power can undermine her confidence. Her green hair, a result of her magnetic aura, makes her easily identifiable and prevents her from operating covertly. Lorna's desire to prove herself can sometimes lead her to take unnecessary risks or make impulsive decisions.
